$comment: Single source of truth for the CI/local build. Each release lists the Spriggit YAML folders to deserialize and where the built .esp lands inside the release (FOMOD) tree. 'dest' paths must match the source= attributes in that release's fomod/ModuleConfig.xml (verified by build/build.ps1 -CheckFomod). Paths are repo-relative, and every patch's sources live under src/<PatchName>/. Optional per-release keys: 'scripts' {from,to} bulk-copies committed .pex; 'assets' [{from,to}] copies committed loose files or folders (Interface/, MCM/, SKSE/, a KID/SPID .ini) into the archive, where 'to' is the path inside the archive ('' = root) and a folder source has its CONTENTS copied into 'to'; 'allowUnreferencedPlugins' silences the warning about a plugin the FOMOD never installs; 'fomod': false ships a plain archive with no installer - the right shape whenever the install has nothing to ask (a single .esp with no options, e.g. a replacement plugin), and build/staging/<name>/fomod/ must then not exist. Optional per-plugin key: 'scripts' [{from,to}] copies individual .pex. Add releases with the /mod-new-plugin skill. An empty 'releases' array is valid - the build reports 'nothing to build' and succeeds, so the repo stays green before the first patch exists.

releases.$comment: Standalone Enderal conversion of johnskyrim's Relentless Sword SE - a PLUGIN ONLY. It carries no meshes or textures: the player installs johnskyrim's mod for its assets (CORE/runed branch, any texture resolution) and disables 'Relentless Sword SE - Johnskyrim.esp', which cannot work here because it masters the three DLC stubs. Six weapons, shadowsteel-tier stats, blueprint-gated forge/temper/dismantle recipes; ESL-flagged, overriding only FlusshaimTemple (to place the blueprint) and _00ETraderCraftingPlansC (to stock it at level 30).
releases.name: Relentless Sword - Enderal Conversion

releases.$comment: Ships only what the conversion CHANGED - the rebuilt plugin, the two rewritten distribution inis and the trimmed MCM config. Install Shazdeh's original mod first, then this over it, the same way the Apocalypse release works. The unmodified third-party parts (Traits.dll, the SWF menus, translations, the .pex set) are deliberately neither committed nor redistributed.
releases.name: Biggie Traits - Enderal Conversion

releases.$comment: Enai Siaion's Triumvirate - Mage Archetypes, converted for Enderal. A REPLACEMENT PLUGIN, the same shape as the Apocalypse release: it ships under the ORIGINAL filename because the mod's two BSAs are named after the plugin and only load while that name is intact, so the player installs Enai's mod for its assets and this replaces the .esp. Also ships three loose .pex - our rebuilt distribution script (the original makes 76 calls against Skyrim NPCs and chests that do not exist in Enderal), plus verbatim copies of Enderal's two dgintimidate* DUMMY stubs, which Triumvirate's BSA would otherwise overwrite with the Brawl Bugs Patch versions. Loose files beat a BSA, so this mod must sit AFTER Triumvirate in MO2's file priority - which it must anyway, to win the .esp. See src/Triumvirate/Scripts/README.md.
releases.name: Triumvirate - Enderal Conversion
